info.name: IRoute — Dynamic Job + POD Flow (no hardcoded A1/A2)
info.description:
# Dynamic Job + POD Flow (v2)

Uses `workflow.allowed_actions[0].action_code` — **no hardcoded A1/A2/OA codes**.

## Before run (portal)
1. Booking **Confirmed**, truck + driver assigned
2. Action Master must include **preshipment** steps for booking:
   Start Job → Pickup → Loading → Confirm Loaded (**Auto Shipment ON**)
3. Set `driver_email`, `driver_password`, `mobile_cod_amount` (COD)
4. Set `base_url` if not `http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/mobile`

## Run order
Run folder **00** then **01** cycles in order (or Run Collection).
Each cycle: **01a Job Detail** sets `execute_action_code` → **01b/01c Execute**.

## If execute_action_code empty
Check Tests tab on Job Detail — message explains `context_label` from API.
